name: rondo-publication-critic-successor-release
runtime_relational_constraints: manifest task identity and every physical file hash and row count match
candidate packet, labels, and quoted continuity basis validate together
pair endpoints share public context and satisfy absolute label closure
train and validation are opened only through separate entrypoints
test has no training or selection loader

consumer_access.train: opens only train candidates and pairs

continuity_label_basis.quote: non-empty canonical substring of the named model-visible field, at most 240 scalars

kinds.boundary: left is Q+ PASS, right is Q- REWRITE, target changes PASS to FAIL, every non-target label is invariant
kinds.soft_only_invariance: both endpoints PASS and every hard label including applicability is invariant

pair.soft_change: null for Boundary; a bounded description of the model-visible soft-only counterfactual for invariance
